page.layout: One page: the digitiser's cover sheet of e-rara.ch. Top right logo; centred title block; below a rule, a multilingual notice on the platform; below another rule, terms-of-use notices; bottom right the Visual Library logo. No printed book text.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not part of the printed book. It gives the title "Petri Rami Basilea ad senatum populumque Basiliensem", author Ramus, Petrus, place and date "[Lausanne], 1571", holding library Universitätsbibliothek Bern, shelf mark MUE H XXII 108 : 4, and a persistent link. Its banner, logo, links and terms of use are left out, as are any stamps or shelf marks. The cover sheet itself is not transcribed.
